name: Web357 Cookie Consent Manager
author: Yiannis Christodoulou

sections.description:
The Web357 Cookie Consent Manager WordPress plugin displays a clean, customizable cookie consent bar at the top or bottom of your WordPress site, helping you meet GDPR, ePrivacy, and modern cookie law requirements. Visitors see your cookies notice on their first visit and can accept it with a single click — the bar then stays hidden on future visits, so the user experience remains smooth and uninterrupted. If you want a lightweight, easy-to-configure cookie consent bar for WordPress, Web357 Cookie Consent Manager is for you.

Basic Features

  • Display a customizable cookie consent bar at the top or bottom of every page on the frontend.
  • Edit the notice message, “Accept” button label, and add a link to your privacy / cookies policy page directly from the settings panel.
  • Customize colors, spacing, and basic styling to match your site’s branding.
  • Visitor’s choice is remembered with a cookie, so the bar stays hidden after acceptance.
  • Consent event logging — see when and from where visitors accepted the cookie notice.
  • Built-in automatic log retention to keep the database clean.
  • Shortcode support to render the cookie notice anywhere on your site.
  • Lightweight and frontend-only — zero impact on your WordPress admin and PageSpeed / Core Web Vitals scores.
  • Works with any modern WordPress theme and page builder (Elementor, Divi, Bricks, Beaver Builder, and more).

Source Code

The PHP source of this plugin is fully readable in the plugin files as distributed.

The admin settings screen is a React/TypeScript single-page application, built into a single JavaScript bundle at public/js/admin-view.js. This bundle is shipped unminified (readable variable/function names, unobfuscated) so its full logic can be reviewed directly from the package.

External Services

This version of the plugin does not connect to any external, third-party service. All settings, cookie categories, and consent logs are stored locally in your WordPress database.
sections.installation:
The plugin is simple to install:

  1. Download the file web357-cookie-consent-manager.zip.
  2. Unzip it.
  3. Upload web357-cookie-consent-manager directory to your /wp-content/plugins directory.
  4. Go to the plugin management page and enable the plugin.
  5. Configure the options from the Web357 Cookie Consent Manager settings page.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin help me comply with GDPR, ePrivacy, and cookie law?

The Web357 Cookie Consent Manager displays a clear cookie notice to every visitor on their first visit, with a link to your cookies/privacy policy page. It is designed to help WordPress site owners meet GDPR, ePrivacy, and similar cookie consent requirements. For full legal compliance in your country, we always recommend consulting a legal expert.

Where does the cookie notification bar appear on my website?

The bar appears on the frontend at the top or bottom of every page, so every visitor sees the notice the first time they land on your site. After they accept (or dismiss) the bar, it stays hidden on the next visits based on your settings.

Can I customize the message, colors, and buttons?

Yes. You can edit the notification text, choose background and text colors, set custom labels for the buttons (for example “Accept”, “Read more”), and add a link to your privacy/cookies policy page — all from the plugin settings, with no coding required.

Will the cookie notice slow down my WordPress site?

No. The plugin is lightweight, only loads its assets on the frontend, and has no impact on the WordPress admin or your PageSpeed / Core Web Vitals scores.

Is the cookie notice shown again to returning visitors?

No. Once a visitor accepts the notice, their choice is stored in a cookie and the bar stays hidden on future visits until the cookie expires or the visitor clears it.

Does it support multilingual sites (WPML, Polylang, TranslatePress)?

Yes. You can translate the notification text directly from the settings, and the plugin works alongside popular multilingual plugins such as WPML, Polylang, and TranslatePress.

Is Web357 Cookie Consent Manager free?

Yes, this is a free WordPress plugin.
